To get a real answer, one of these would do it:

One general caution, clearly labelled as generic rather than Quorvel-specific: many event buses default a single message to around 1 MB, so 2 MB snapshots commonly require an explicit limit increase on both producer and broker, and can hit per-partition or per-batch caps even when the message cap allows it.
